title: Rupee rises 7 paise to 93.70 against US dollar in early trade - The Economic Times
text:
The rupee strengthened 7 paise to 93.70 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, supported by sustained foreign fund inflows, easing crude oil prices and improving geopolitical sentiment. The domestic currency has emerged as one of Asia's best performers in FY27, with traders expecting continued overseas investor participation to provide a buffer against external uncertainties.
